def: Speculative-decoding drafters that reuse the target model's hidden states: EAGLE drafts at the feature level, EAGLE-2 adds dynamic draft trees, and EAGLE-3 predicts tokens from fused multi-layer features.
practice: Supported in vLLM, SGLang and TensorRT-LLM and among the fastest trained drafters at small batch sizes; each target model needs its own trained drafter, and gains shrink as batches grow.
